system.description:
Deal [2D + (Magic Power)] magical damage to the target.

(Extra): A secondary target within a range of [Target: Single / Range: 2 Sq.] from the initial target takes [SRx5] direct damage. This damage triggers [Weakness] on the secondary target, as if they had failed their [Dodge Check].

Attack magic that shoots a bundle of converged lightning. The lightning strike explodes on impact, damaging nearby enemies.
